poi_mubz2l7a_dc0x28.name: Selwo Marina
poi_mubz2l7a_dc0x28.description: A marine park with dolphins, sea lions, penguins and exotic birds, with shows throughout the day.
poi_mubz2l7a_dc0x28.short_tip: Check the show times as you go in. It's right next to the cable car.

poi_mubz2mqg_py03or.name: Sea Life Benalmádena
poi_mubz2mqg_py03or.description: An aquarium in Puerto Marina with sharks, turtles and jellyfish, and an underwater tunnel.
poi_mubz2mqg_py03or.short_tip: A good plan with kids or on a rainy day.

poi_mubz2j8b_dm8c8t.name: Benalmádena Butterfly Park (Monowa)
poi_mubz2j8b_dm8c8t.description: A butterfly house in a Thai temple-style building, with over 1,500 tropical butterflies flying free, plus reptiles and insects.
poi_mubz2j8b_dm8c8t.short_tip: Go mid-morning: butterflies are more active when it's warm.

poi_mubz2iph_biiuod.name: Colomares Castle
poi_mubz2iph_biiuod.description: A monument to Christopher Columbus built between 1987 and 1994, mixing Romanesque, Gothic and Mudéjar styles to tell the story of the discovery of America. It holds what is said to be the world's smallest church.
poi_mubz2iph_biiuod.short_tip: A one-hour visit. Best by car: it's high above Arroyo de la Miel.

poi_mubz2izo_jirste.name: Enlightenment Stupa
poi_mubz2izo_jirste.description: The largest Buddhist stupa in the Western world, 33 metres high, on a hill overlooking the sea. Inside is a meditation hall decorated with paintings.
poi_mubz2izo_jirste.short_tip: Free entry. Take off your shoes and keep quiet inside.

poi_mubz2jf8_k9tk83.name: Felipe Orlando Pre-Columbian Art Museum
poi_mubz2jf8_k9tk83.description: One of Spain's most important collections of pre-Columbian art, with pieces from Mesoamerica and South America, plus local archaeology.

poi_mubz2jp9_0ify2g.name: Benalmádena History Centre
poi_mubz2jp9_0ify2g.description: An interpretation centre on the town's history, from prehistory to the arrival of tourism.

poi_mubz2k0o_b0qi5w.name: Church of Santo Domingo de Guzmán
poi_mubz2k0o_b0qi5w.description: A 16th- to 18th-century church at the top of Benalmádena Pueblo, overlooking the coast.
poi_mubz2k0o_b0qi5w.short_tip: Next to the Jardines del Muro: see both together.

poi_mubz2k95_4eni0z.name: Jardines del Muro
poi_mubz2k95_4eni0z.description: Terraced gardens in the village, with fountains, pergolas and sea views, next to the church of Santo Domingo.

poi_mubz2khr_lhg491.name: Plaza de España and La Niña de Benalmádena
poi_mubz2khr_lhg491.description: The main square of Benalmádena Pueblo, with the fountain of La Niña, a bronze sculpture that has become the town's symbol.
poi_mubz2khr_lhg491.short_tip: A good starting point to explore the village on foot.

poi_mubz2kqb_6pwjme.name: Parque de la Paloma
poi_mubz2kqb_6pwjme.description: A large urban park with a lake, a waterfall and free-roaming animals: rabbits, ducks, peacocks and hens. A family favourite.
poi_mubz2kqb_6pwjme.short_tip: Free entry. Perfect for a picnic with kids.

poi_mubz2lft_rfy382.name: Mount Calamorro
poi_mubz2lft_rfy382.description: A summit of almost 800 metres with views over the whole coast and, on clear days, Africa. Reach it by cable car or on a demanding footpath.
poi_mubz2lft_rfy382.short_tip: Walking up is free but steep: about two hours.

poi_mubz2loo_dsnwmv.name: Benalmádena House of Culture
poi_mubz2loo_dsnwmv.description: A cultural centre in Arroyo de la Miel with exhibitions, concerts and theatre.

poi_mubz2m5i_629of3.name: El Bil-Bil Castle
poi_mubz2m5i_629of3.description: A red, Arab-style building from 1934 on the seafront that now hosts exhibitions and concerts. One of the most photographed spots on the coast.
poi_mubz2m5i_629of3.short_tip: Exhibitions are free. Right on the seafront promenade.

poi_mubz2n0p_dxuukc.name: Los Molinillos Roman Villa
poi_mubz2n0p_dxuukc.description: Remains of a Roman villa and fish-salting factory from the 1st to the 5th century, beside the seafront promenade.
poi_mubz2n0p_dxuukc.short_tip: Free access. You'll see it in a few minutes.

poi_mubz2n83_sub71a.name: Benalroma Roman Site
poi_mubz2n83_sub71a.description: Remains of a Roman villa with fish-salting tanks, uncovered by the coast.
poi_mubz2n83_sub71a.short_tip: A short visit: combine it with Los Molinillos.

poi_mt0qfcfn_r5wfmx.name: Puerto Marina
poi_mt0qfcfn_r5wfmx.description: A marina with almost fairy-tale architecture, islands, bridges and terraces, several times named one of the best in the world.

poi_mtybk2re_h1jmd9.name: Benalmádena Hindu Temple
poi_mtybk2re_h1jmd9.description: A colourful Hindu temple in Arroyo de la Miel, open to visitors, where the community holds its festivals.
poi_mtybk2re_h1jmd9.short_tip: Respect the worship: take off your shoes inside.
